response.rationale: Option C is the most specific supertype of the top-ranked leaf 'Multisystem Inflammatory Syndrome in Children (MIS-C) with central nervous system vasculitis and acute ischemic stroke', explicitly mentioning both MIS-C and acute ischemic stroke. Option A is a broader supertype, mentioning MIS-C with neurological involvement but not specifically ischemic stroke. Option D is also a supertype, focusing on COVID-19-associated cerebral vasculitis (ischemic stroke) but omitting MIS-C. All three matched options have the same best_rank and support_score, so specificity is used for ordering. Option B is unrelated and therefore ranked last.
